name: Broadcom
notes: Confirmed live at broadcom.wd1.myworkdayjobs.com/en-US/External_Career (tenant=broadcom, site=External_Career). Requires a POST with WORKDAY_SEARCH_BODY as the JSON body — a plain GET returns nothing. True total confirmed via full pagination: 371 live postings (19 page(s) fetched).

name: Payhawk
notes: payhawk.com/careers is Greenhouse, slug 'payhawkio' — NOT 'payhawk', which 404s. CORRECTED: an earlier version of this table used boards-api.eu.greenhouse.io because the public career site lives on job-boards.eu.greenhouse.io, but that 'eu.' API host doesn't serve job JSON at all — it 302s to /users/sign_in (an admin login), so it silently looked 'down' on every later revalidation. The actual public Job Board API is unified on the plain boards-api.greenhouse.io host regardless of which regional domain the career site itself is served from. Confirmed live: 45 postings. True total confirmed via full pagination: 45 live postings (1 page(s) fetched).

name: Nexo
notes: Directly verified: 26 live postings, many Sofia/Bulgaria-based. Breezy HR isn't one of the ATSes named in the brief but exposes a genuinely public, unauthenticated JSON feed. True total confirmed via full pagination: 26 live postings (1 page(s) fetched).

name: Dreamix
notes: dreamix.eu/careers links to apply.workable.com/dreamix-ltd. Directly verified: 10 live postings, mostly Sofia/remote. True total confirmed via full pagination: 9 live postings (1 page(s) fetched).

name: Wise
notes: wise.jobs footer states 'Career site system powered by SmartRecruiters Attrax'. jobs.smartrecruiters.com/Wise/... shows real live postings across many countries. NOTE: boards-api.greenhouse.io/v1/boards/wise/jobs also returns 200 with jobs, but that board belongs to an unrelated US company also named Wise — a false positive, do not use it.
